name: Joi-san no Oiitsuke!! ~Ecchi na Shinsatsu Shite Ageru♪~
original_name: 女医さんのお言いつけっ!!～エッチな診察してあげる♪～
source:
Yuuta suffers from an obstinate disease and is taken to hospital. A female doctor in charge of him says, "You'll need to have an operation, but it is really tough." He decides to have an operation and says to her, "If I get well, can you be my girlfriend?" On the next day, the operation is finished, and it goes well. When he regains his consciousness, the female doctor stands in front of him...

[From ErogeShop]
